notes:
Checked on 2026-10-10 using Python urllib with User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1, without credentials. Read the complete 134864-character markdown conversion, including references and Appendix A; confirmed the PDF contains 33 pages and inspected relevant PDF pages and external-link annotations with PyMuPDF. The saved source is arXiv:2411.03295v5 (30 July 2025), carrying ACM DOI 10.1145/3757591. No study-specific data-sharing, code-release, preregistration, external supplement, embargo, or data-on-request statement was found. Acknowledgments on p. 25 contain funding/support and reviewer thanks only. The form's data_and_code.data_url and code_url are both empty.

The quoted statements record embedded study materials and third-party software/instrument pointers; they do not assert that participant data or the authors' analysis code were released. Examples appear in Table 1; survey options, rewriting prompts and interface examples in Sections 3.1-3.2; thread titles, generation settings and prompts in Appendix A (pp. 30-31); remaining appendix tables report aggregates. The Creative Commons notice applies to the article, and no dataset license was confirmed. The preprint, generic software/model pages, and other studies' datasets are not counted as c906 deposits.

The publisher landing page https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3757591 and the DOI redirect both returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare 'Just a moment...' challenge. Stopped without attempting to bypass the bot check. Publisher supplements and equivalence with the version of record could therefore not be confirmed. Both the saved-version and current arXiv abstract pages loaded publicly (HTTP 200), with no study-specific repository/supplement link identified.

Every unique HTTP(S) URL found in the PDF text/link annotations was requested, along with the current arXiv and direct publisher pages. PDF hyperlink targets were used to avoid markdown line-wrap artifacts in reference URLs.
